title: CNSS skill D modular-addition acquisition diagnostic
objective: Determine whether skill D failed because of task specification, implementation semantics, optimization, representational capacity or generalization, without changing the original partner experiment.
scientific_boundary: This is a read-only acquisition diagnostic over the completed partner-generalization artifacts. It cannot establish a new neural capability or retroactively qualify the partner experiment.
read_only_diagnostics: independently verify the exhaustive modular-addition oracle and bit ordering
audit train/validation/test partitions, target uniqueness and composition leakage boundaries
compare D with A, B and C under the identical 4-lambda, 3-seed, 2,000-update artifact set
evaluate simple non-neural baselines including exact oracle, identity, no-carry XOR and target-bit majority
replay final adapters and checkpoint trajectories from durable artifacts
stratify D failures by carry count, carry-chain length, modular wraparound, Hamming weight, output bit and error pattern
measure final read-only loss and gradient norms without optimizer updates

corrective_training_controls.design: Matched 2x2 control crossing adapter rank 8 versus 32 with 2,000 versus 8,000 updates, preserving the same workspace, operation, partitions, seeds, optimizer family, numerical safeguards and held-out gate. The four registered lambda values remain separate conditions; no result is selected from the current diagnostic.
corrective_training_controls.purpose: Separate optimization horizon from adapter capacity before changing the operation representation.
